press_references.value: FinBursa Launches the MENA Region’s First Neutral Mobile App for Direct-to-Source Private Market Investment Discovery

product_launches.description: FinBursa launched its first consumer-facing investor mobile app in the MENA region, providing a neutral, AI-powered gateway for private market investors to discover and directly engage with capital seekers such as startups, private companies, and funds.

overview_description.description: FinBursa is an AI-native operating platform for professional participants in private markets, with embedded AI agents across deal management, due diligence, fundraising, and investor engagement. It helps teams run relationships, deals, and fundraising in one place instead of across many disconnected tools. It is particularly well-suited to small and mid-market firms that need institutional-grade infrastructure without the complexity and cost of heavyweight legacy systems.
